title: Split array largest sum
statement:
Split nums (non-negative integers) into k non-empty contiguous parts to minimise the largest part's sum; return that minimum.

Constraints: up to 10⁴ elements in the classic version (larger here), k ≤ min(50, n).
hints: This is the shipping problem in disguise.
A DP over (index, parts) also works in O(k n²); binary search on the answer is O(n log sum).

solution.explanation: "Minimise the maximum" is the strongest signal for binary search on the answer: test a cap with a greedy count of parts (at most k needed?), and search the smallest feasible cap. Same code as the shipping problem; recognising that is the skill. Note the sums can exceed 32 bits in C++.
